title: Path Detective
prompt: Write check(path) that returns "missing" when the path does not exist and "found" when it does. Use pathlib.

tests.name: exists vs missing
tests.code:
import os as _os
_os.remove("temp_probe.txt") if _os.path.exists("temp_probe.txt") else None
open("temp_probe.txt", "w").write("x")
assert check("temp_probe.txt") == "found", "existing file must be found"
_os.remove("temp_probe.txt")
assert check("definitely_not_here.bin") == "missing", "missing file must be missing"
assert "Path" in code, "use pathlib"
